notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only source that names this tower is the Forest Fire Lookout Association county list (name, coordinates, type, status). Starr's 2011 list of DEC stations does not include it, so no build date, staffing, design or fate can be sourced. The alphabetical nysffla.org list has no Bull entry either. The DEC source is general background, not about this tower. The sentences that say no source describes the site today, and that the hill is absent from Starr's list, have no quote because they report absence. A search of Orange County newspapers or local history would be the next step before this story is expanded. No photos recorded.
